# PerturbationSpaceTrajectory

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A trajectory of system states expressed as deviations from a nominal operating point, used to assess stability without linearization. Supports iNEST's nonlinear, event-driven processing by offering a non-linear stability view compatible with spike-based dynamics.
